observations.body: Jesus enters a garden known to Judas, steps forward before soldiers and officers, identifies himself, protects the disciples, and tells Peter to put away the sword and names the Father’s cup.

payload.posture: Read John 18:1–11 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus enters a garden known to Judas, steps forward before soldiers and officers, identifies himself, protects the disciples, and tells Peter to put away the sword and names the Father’s cup. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
